ev_0006.summary: Rectangle ABCD confirmed with A(47,65), D(441,65), C(440,300), B(48,300). E(138,107) is a labelled interior point with a verified right-angle mark at E between EA and EB (dot product of E->A and E->B is about 0). The supervisor's premise is contradicted: E does NOT lie on a single straight line from A to C. Line A->C at x=138 would be at y~119, 12 px below E. Instead, detected seg_03 runs from C(440,300) through E(138,107) and continues to about (116,93), so EC is collinear with that line, and it is not AC. Detected seg_04 runs from B(48,306) to E(137,109), which is BE. Detected seg_07 runs from E toward A(55,68), which is AE, and its slope (~0.46) matches A->E. AE and EC meet at E at a clear angle, so A-E-C is not straight. No 'AC' diagonal was detected as a segment. merge_collinear_segments returned no merged spans, so collinearity was checked geometrically from endpoints. circle_01 is rejected as spurious per supervisor instruction.

params.summary:
Produced a compiling TikZ figure (best_version = v1, v2 is the latest repair). The figure is a rectangle ABCD with labels A, B, C, D, E and a verified right-angle mark at E between EA and EB, plus segment BE and a polyline A-E-C. Labels were bound by the CV tools and confirmed visually. The detected circle_01 was judged spurious because no arc is visible in the original.

Critic on v1 scored 0.72 (checklist 0.938) and flagged the A-E stroke as curved and the strokes as thinner than the original. The repair (v2) removed any arc and widened the strokes to 1.5pt. The critic re-run on v2 returned a cached verdict identical to v1, so v2 has not been independently re-scored.
unresolved: The critic's 'curved A-E' complaint was not independently verified on v2. CV line evidence shows AE (slope ~0.46) and EC (slope ~0.64) meet at E with a real kink, which conflicts with the expectation that A, E, C are collinear (E as foot of the altitude from B onto AC). This needs a check against the original figure before the polyline is accepted as final.
Stroke weight is only approximate (1.5pt chosen by the repair agent, not measured).
The critic cache prevented a fresh score on v2.
